introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: LogoLoco ('we', 'our', or 'us') respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our AI logo generation service.

dataCollection.title: Information We Collect
dataCollection.content: We collect the following types of information:

items.name: Name and contact information (email address) when you create an account
items.email: Email address for account management and communications
items.usage: Usage data and analytics to improve our service

dataUsage.title: How We Use Your Information
dataUsage.content: We use your information to provide, maintain, and improve our services, process transactions, send you technical notices and support messages, and respond to your comments and requests.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.content: We retain your generated logos for at least 1 year from the date of creation. You will receive an email notification before any logos are deleted. Account data is retained for as long as your account remains active.

yourRights.title: Your Rights
yourRights.content: You have the following rights regarding your personal data:

items.access: Access - You can request access to your personal data
items.correction: Correction - You can update or correct your information
items.deletion: Deletion - You can request deletion of your account and data
items.export: Export - You can request a copy of your data

security.title: Data Security
security.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

cookies.title: Cookies and Tracking
cookies.content: We use essential cookies to maintain your session and preferences. We do not use tracking cookies for advertising purposes.

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.content: Our service is not intended for children under 16. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 16.

international.title: International Data Transfers
international.content: Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your own. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place.
